entry_rationale: Pay 75 million US 10-year at 5.15; +21bp over one month and +6bp versus the prior freeze is the continuation.
entry_thesis: US 10Y at 5.15 is still in a persistent backup, +21bp over one month and +6bp versus the prior freeze at 5.09, with WTI 103.66 and Brent 109.55 holding term-premium support and VIX 18.44 offering no risk-off bid for duration. That is the clean continuation; fading it because front-end STIR has lagged would be premature. The book short in SOFR_2027-03 from 4.6217 versus live 4.52 is the wrong tenor: it is already ~10bp adverse, the freeze supplies no independent Mar27 uptrend, and adding would only average a loser. Close the Mar27 pay and replace it with a US 10Y pay; USDJPY 158.245 is the same higher-yield impulse in FX but is only a live print, so rates are cleaner overnight.
